% Use a local dictionary for all symbols.  /FVDict 100 dict def FVDict begin

% General image parameters *********************************************

/ImageWidth 0 def /ImageHeight 0 def % Assume 8-bit color or grayscale values.
/NumBits 8 def

% Other useful global variables ****************************************

/RGBTriple 3 string def

% Boolean for level 2 output /Level2
    systemdict /setcolorspace known systemdict /filter known and def

/MaxRunLength 128 def    % longest possible run in standard encoding /RunBuf
MaxRunLength 3 mul string def    % room for longest run

% Timing procs *********************************************************

/rtime 0 def /utime 0 def

/DoTiming false def

DoTiming { %ifelse
    /start_timing {      systemdict /realtime known {          /rtime realtime
def      } if      /utime usertime def      gsave
    } bind def

    /stop_timing {      grestore      systemdict /realtime known {
/rtime realtime rtime sub 1000 div def      } if      /utime usertime utime
sub 1000 div def      currentfont          /Helvetica-Bold findfont 12
scalefont setfont          150 150 moveto          (user time ) show utime 15
string cvs show          systemdict /realtime known {           (,  real time
) show rtime 15 string cvs show          } if          Level2 { %ifelse
       (  Level 2) show          }{ %else           (  Level 1) show
} ifelse      setfont
    } bind def }{ %else
    /start_timing {} def
    /stop_timing {} def } ifelse

% Stroke adjustment ****************************************************

% Boolean for stroke adjustment /DoStrokeAdjust false def

DoStrokeAdjust { %if
    systemdict /setstrokeadjust known { %ifelse      true setstrokeadjust
    }{ %else      /old_moveto /moveto load def      /moveto { %def
transform          .25 sub round .25 add exch          .25 sub round .25 add
exch          itransform          old_moveto      } bind def      /old_lineto
/lineto load def      /lineto { %def          transform          .25 sub round
.25 add exch          .25 sub round .25 add exch          itransform
old_lineto      } bind def      /old_rmoveto /rmoveto load def      /rmoveto {
%def          transform          round exch          round exch
itransform          old_rmoveto      } bind def      /old_rlineto /rlineto
load def      /rlineto { %def          transform          round exch
round exch          itransform          old_rlineto      } bind def
    } ifelse } if

% Image initialization *************************************************

% Predefine internal names so they cannot be accidentally bound to operators.
/PageHeight 0 def /PageWidth 0 def /DoRotate false def

/header        % scale auto_scale xres yres header - { %def
    /ImageHeight exch def
    /ImageWidth exch def

    1 eq {     % if auto_scale is true      pop  % discard scale factor
   clippath pathbbox   % llx lly urx ury <- top of stack      2 index
sub          % llx lly urx ury-lly      /PageHeight exch def     % llx lly urx
    2 index sub         % llx lly urx-llx      /PageWidth exch def % llx lly
  translate      % position at lower left corner of page

     % See if rotating the image fills the page better (by at least 10%).
 ImageWidth ImageHeight div dup     % image aspect ratio      PageWidth
PageHeight div dup % page aspect ratio      3 -1 roll % image_aspect
page_aspect page_aspect image_aspect      0.95 lt exch 1.05 gt and { /DoRotate
true def } if      0.95 lt exch 1.05 gt and { /DoRotate true def } if

     % Do the appropriate scaling, rotation, and translation.      % Scale the
image by the smaller of the two page-to-image ratios      % (so both width and
height still fit).      DoRotate { %ifelse          PageWidth ImageHeight div
PageHeight ImageWidth div 2 copy le {           pop          }{ %else
         exch pop          } ifelse          dup dup scale          90 rotate
     0 ImageHeight neg translate          dup PageHeight exch div ImageWidth
sub 2 div          exch PageWidth exch div ImageHeight sub 2 div neg
translate      }{ %else          PageWidth ImageWidth div PageHeight
ImageHeight div 2 copy le {           pop          }{ %else           exch pop
     } ifelse          dup dup scale          dup PageWidth exch div
ImageWidth sub 2 div          exch PageHeight exch div ImageHeight sub 2 div
         translate      } ifelse
    }{ %else (EPS file)      100 100 translate      dup scale
    } ifelse % auto_scale } bind def

/BorderWidth 1 def

/border   % - border - {
    gsave      0 setgray % border is always black      BorderWidth
setlinewidth      newpath      % Offset border by half the line width.
  BorderWidth 2 div dup moveto      ImageWidth BorderWidth sub 0 rlineto
    0 ImageHeight BorderWidth sub rlineto      ImageWidth BorderWidth sub neg
0 rlineto      closepath      stroke
    grestore } bind def

% PseudoColor RLE image procs ******************************************

/NumCols 256 def    % 2^NumBits

% Predefine internal names so they cannot be accidentally bound to operators.
/Colormap 0 def /Graymap 0 def

% Read colormap into an array of strings (one string per entry).
/read_colormap_as_array  % - read_colormap_as_array - { %def
    /Colormap NumCols array def
    0 1 NumCols 1 sub { %for      Colormap exch      % Create new 3-byte RGB
string for each color entry.      currentfile 3 string readhexstring pop
     put  % put RGB triple string into Colormap array
    } for } bind def

% Read colormap into a single long string.  /read_colormap_as_string     % -
read_colormap_as_string - { %def
    /Colormap NumCols 3 mul string def
    currentfile Colormap readhexstring pop pop } bind def

% Read graymap into a single long string.  /read_graymap_as_string % -
read_graymap_as_string - { %def
    /Graymap NumCols string def
    currentfile Graymap readhexstring pop pop } bind def

% Read colormap, convert to grayscale, and store as a single long string.
/read_colormap_as_gray_string  % - read_colormap_as_gray_string - { %def
    /Graymap NumCols string def
    0 1 NumCols 1 sub { %for      Graymap exch   % Graymap loopindex <- top of
stack      currentfile RGBTriple readhexstring pop      dup 0 get .3 mul    %
convert RGB triple to integer gray value      exch dup 1 get .59 mul      exch
2 get .11 mul      add add cvi      put  % put gray value into Graymap array
    } for } bind def

/read_colormap % - read_colormap - { %def
    Level2 { %ifelse      read_colormap_as_string      [ /Indexed /DeviceRGB
NumCols 1 sub Colormap ] setcolorspace
    }{ %else      systemdict /colorimage known { %ifelse
read_colormap_as_array      }{ %else          read_colormap_as_gray_string
  } ifelse
    } ifelse } bind def

/read_graymap  % - read_graymap - { %def
    read_graymap_as_string
    Level2 { %if      [ /Indexed /DeviceGray NumCols 1 sub Graymap ]
setcolorspace
    } if } bind def

/ColorIndex 1 string def

% WARNING: the token RUNLENGTH is a placeholder for a "put" !!!  % This will
break if RUNLENGTH is not the 2nd token in decode_pseudocolor_rle !!
/decode_pseudocolor_rle % - decode_pseudocolor_rle string-of-RGB-values { %def
    currentfile RUNLENGTH readhexstring pop  % get length string
    0 get % get length byte from string
    dup 128 gt { %ifelse      % If length byte is > 128, then the pseudocolor
index which follows      % it should be converted into a RGB triple, and then
replicated      % 257 - length times.      257 exch sub   % number of
replications      3 mul     % number of bytes in the resulting run
  RunBuf    % now have nbytes RunBuf <- top of stack      Colormap
     currentfile ColorIndex readhexstring pop      0 get     % get numeric
color index out of ColorIndex string      get  % use index to get color string
out of colormap array      % now have nbytes RunBuf colorstring <- top of
stack      0 3 4 index 1 sub { %for          2 index exch 2 index % massage
into RunBuf loopindex colorstring          putinterval  % put colorstring into
RunBuf at loopindex location      } for      pop  % remove colorstring, now
have nbytes RunBuf      0 3 -1 roll getinterval  % return valid part of RunBuf
    }{ %else      % If length byte is < 128, then the length+1 pseudocolor
indices which      % follow it are to be converted into RGB triples, and then
copied      % literally.      % (If length byte = 128, this is EOD marker -
should never see this.)      1 add     % number of pseudocolor indices      3
mul     % number of bytes in the result      RunBuf    % now have nbytes
RunBuf <- top of stack      0 3 3 index 1 sub { %for          1 index
exch % RunBuf loopindex <- top of stack          Colormap          currentfile
ColorIndex readhexstring pop          0 get % get numeric color index out of
ColorIndex string          get        % use index to get color string out of
colormap array          putinterval     % put color string into RunBuf      }
for      % still have nbytes RunBuf <- top of stack      0 3 -1 roll
getinterval    % get correct length substring of RunBuf
    } ifelse } %def dup 1 1 string put  % replace RUNLENGTH with inline 1-byte
string bind def

% WARNING: the token RUNLENGTH is a placeholder for a "put" !!!  % This will
break if RUNLENGTH is not the 2nd token in decode_pseudocolor_rle !!  % -
decode_pseudocolor_rle_as_gray string-of-gray-values
/decode_pseudocolor_rle_as_gray { %def
    currentfile RUNLENGTH readhexstring pop  % get length string
    0 get % get length byte from string
    dup 128 gt { %ifelse      % If length byte is > 128, then the pseudocolor
index which follows      % it should be converted into a gray value, and then
replicated      % 257 - length times.      257 exch sub   % number of
replications (and bytes in the result)      RunBuf    % now have nbytes RunBuf
<- top of stack      Graymap      currentfile ColorIndex readhexstring pop
     0 get     % get numeric color index out of ColorIndex string      get  %
use index to get gray value integer out of colormap array      % now have
nbytes RunBuf grayvalue <- top of stack      0 1 4 index 1 sub { %for
2 index exch 2 index % massage into RunBuf loopindex grayvalue
put          % put grayvalue into RunBuf at loopindex location      } for
    pop  % remove colorstring, now have nbytes RunBuf      0 3 -1 roll
getinterval  % return valid part of RunBuf
    }{ %else      % If length byte is < 128, then the length+1 pseudocolor
indices which      % follow it are to be converted into gray values, and then
copied      % literally.      % (If length byte = 128, this is EOD marker -
should never see this.)      1 add     % number of pseudocolor indices (and
bytes in the result)      RunBuf    % now have nbytes RunBuf <- top of stack
   0 1 3 index 1 sub { %for          1 index exch    % RunBuf loopindex <- top
of stack          Graymap          currentfile ColorIndex readhexstring pop
       0 get % get numeric color index out of ColorIndex string
get     % use index to get gray value integer out of colormap array
put      % put grayvalue into RunBuf at loopindex location      } for      %
still have nbytes RunBuf <- top of stack      0 3 -1 roll getinterval  % get
correct length substring of RunBuf
    } ifelse } %def dup 1 1 string put  % replace RUNLENGTH with inline 1-byte
string bind def

/pseudo_color_rle_image  % - pseudo_color_rle_image - { %def
    Level2 { %ifelse      9 dict begin          /ImageType 1 def
/Width ImageWidth def          /Height ImageHeight def          /ImageMatrix [
1 0 0 1 0 0 ] def          /DataSource currentfile /ASCIIHexDecode filter
      /RunLengthDecode filter def          /BitsPerComponent NumBits def
/Decode [ 0 NumCols 1 sub ] def          %/Interpolate true def
currentdict      end      image
    }{ %else      ImageWidth ImageHeight NumBits [ 1 0 0 1 0 0 ]
systemdict /colorimage known { %ifelse           { decode_pseudocolor_rle }
false 3 colorimage          }{ %else           {
decode_pseudocolor_rle_as_gray } image          } ifelse      currentfile 1
string readhexstring pop pop     % consume Hex EOD marker      { %loop
currentfile 80 string readline pop          (>) search { %ifelse           pop
pop pop exit          }{ %else           pop          } ifelse      }
loop   % consume RunLength EOD (a '>' character)
    } ifelse } bind def

/pseudo_gray_rle_image   % - pseudo_gray_rle_image - { %def
    Level2 { %ifelse      [ /Indexed /DeviceGray NumCols 1 sub Graymap ]
setcolorspace      9 dict begin          /ImageType 1 def          /Width
ImageWidth def          /Height ImageHeight def          /ImageMatrix [ 1 0 0
1 0 0 ] def          /DataSource currentfile /ASCIIHexDecode filter
       /RunLengthDecode filter def          /BitsPerComponent NumBits def
       /Decode [ 0 NumCols 1 sub ] def          %/Interpolate true def
currentdict      end      image
    }{ %else      ImageWidth ImageHeight NumBits [ 1 0 0 1 0 0 ]          {
decode_pseudocolor_rle_as_gray } image      currentfile 1 string readhexstring
pop pop   % consume Hex EOD marker      { %loop          currentfile 80 string
readline pop          (>) search { %ifelse           pop pop pop exit
}{ %else           pop          } ifelse      } loop    % consume RunLength
EOD (a '>' character)
    } ifelse } bind def

% RGB RLE image procs **************************************************

% WARNING: the token RUNLENGTH is a placeholder for a "put" !!!  % This will
break if RUNLENGTH is not the 2nd token in decode_rgb_rle !!!
/decode_rgb_rle % - decode_rgb_rle string-of-rgb-values { %def
    currentfile RUNLENGTH readhexstring pop  % get length string
    0 get % get length byte from string
    dup 128 gt { %ifelse      % If length byte is > 128, then the RGB triple
which follows it      % should be replicated 257 - length times.      257 exch
sub % number of replications      3 mul          % number of bytes in the
resulting RGB run      RunBuf      currentfile RGBTriple readhexstring pop %
get RGB triple string      % now have nbytes RunBuf RGBTriple <- top of stack
     0 3 4 index 1 sub { %for          2 index exch 2 index % massage into
RunBuf loopindex RGBTriple          putinterval  % put RGBTriple into RunBuf
at loopindex location      } for      pop  % remove RGBTriple, now have nbytes
RunBuf      0 3 -1 roll getinterval  % return valid part of RunBuf
    }{ %else      % If length byte is < 128, then the length+1 RGB triples
which      % follow it are to be copied literally.      % (If length byte =
128, this is EOD marker - should never see this.)      1 add     % number of
RGB triples      3 mul     % number of bytes      RunBuf 0 3 -1 roll  %
massage into RunBuf 0 nbytes      getinterval         % get correct length
substring of RunBuf      currentfile exch readhexstring pop % read data into
substring
    } ifelse } %def dup 1 1 string put  % replace RUNLENGTH with inline 1-byte
string bind def

% WARNING: the token RUNLENGTH is a placeholder for a "put" !!!  % This will
break if RUNLENGTH is not the 2nd token in decode_rgb_rle_as_gray !!
/decode_rgb_rle_as_gray % - decode_rgb_rle_as_gray string-of-gray-values {
%def
    currentfile RUNLENGTH readhexstring pop  % get length string
    0 get % get length byte from string
    dup 128 gt { %ifelse      % If length byte is > 128, then the RGB triple
which follows it      % should be converted to gray and then replicated 257 -
length times.      257 exch sub % number of replications (and number of gray
value bytes)      RunBuf      currentfile RGBTriple readhexstring pop % get
RGB triple string      dup 0 get .3 mul      exch dup 1 get .59 mul      exch
2 get .11 mul      add add cvi      % now have nbytes RunBuf grayvalue <- top
of stack      0 1 4 index 1 sub { %for          2 index exch 2 index % massage
into RunBuf loopindex grayvalue          put        % put grayvalue into
RunBuf at loopindex location      } for      pop  % remove grayvalue, now have
nbytes RunBuf      0 3 -1 roll getinterval  % return valid part of RunBuf
    }{ %else      % If length byte is < 128, then the length+1 RGB triples
which      % follow it are to be converted to gray and then copied literally.
  % (If length byte = 128, this is EOD marker - should never see this.)      1
add     % number of RGB triples      RunBuf RGBTriple      % now have nbytes
RunBuf RGBTriple <- top of stack      0 1 4 index 1 sub { % for          2
index exch 2 index % massage into RunBuf loopindex RGBTriple
currentfile exch readhexstring pop          dup 0 get .3 mul          exch dup
1 get .59 mul          exch 2 get .11 mul          add add cvi          put
    } for      pop  % remove RGBTriple, now have nbytes RunBuf      0 3 -1
roll getinterval   % return valid part of RunBuf
    } ifelse } %def dup 1 1 string put  % replace RUNLENGTH with inline 1-byte
string bind def

/rgb_rle_image % - rgb_rle_image - { %def
    systemdict /setcolorspace known { %ifelse      [ /DeviceRGB ]
setcolorspace      9 dict begin          /ImageType 1 def          /Width
ImageWidth def          /Height ImageHeight def          /ImageMatrix [ 1 0 0
1 0 0 ] def          /DataSource { decode_rgb_rle } def
/BitsPerComponent NumBits def          /Decode [ 0 1 0 1 0 1 ] def
%/Interpolate true def          currentdict      end      image
    }{ %else      ImageWidth ImageHeight NumBits [ 1 0 0 1 0 0 ]
systemdict /colorimage known { %ifelse           { decode_rgb_rle }
      false 3 colorimage          }{ %else           { decode_rgb_rle_as_gray
} image          } ifelse
    } ifelse } bind def

% Grayscale RLE image procs **************************************************

/GrayValue 1 string def

% WARNING: the token RUNLENGTH is a placeholder for a "put" !!!  % This will
break if RUNLENGTH is not the 2nd token in decode_gray_rle !!!
/decode_gray_rle    % - decode_gray_rle string-of-gray-values { %def
    currentfile RUNLENGTH readhexstring pop  % get length string
    0 get % get length byte from string
    dup 128 gt { %ifelse      % If length byte is > 128, then the gray value
which follows it      % should be replicated 257 - length times.      257 exch
sub % number of replications (and number of bytes)      RunBuf
 currentfile GrayValue readhexstring pop % get gray value string      % now
have nbytes RunBuf GrayValue <- top of stack      0 1 4 index 1 sub { %for
         2 index exch 2 index % massage into RunBuf loopindex GrayValue
putinterval  % put GrayValue into RunBuf at loopindex location      } for
   pop  % remove GrayValue, now have nbytes RunBuf      0 3 -1 roll
getinterval    % return valid part of RunBuf
    }{ %else      % If length byte is < 128, then the length+1 gray values
which      % follow it are to be copied literally.      % (If length byte =
128, this is EOD marker - should never see this.)      1 add     % number of
gray values (and number of bytes)      RunBuf 0 3 -1 roll  % massage into
RunBuf 0 nbytes      getinterval         % get correct length substring of
RunBuf      currentfile exch readhexstring pop % read data into substring
    } ifelse } %def dup 1 1 string put  % replace RUNLENGTH with inline 1-byte
string bind def

/gray_rle_image     % - gray_rle_image - { %def
    Level2 { %ifelse      [ /DeviceGray ] setcolorspace      9 dict begin
     /ImageType 1 def          /Width ImageWidth def          /Height
ImageHeight def          /ImageMatrix [ 1 0 0 1 0 0 ] def          /DataSource
currentfile /ASCIIHexDecode filter           /RunLengthDecode filter def
/BitsPerComponent NumBits def          /Decode [ 0 1 ] def
%/Interpolate true def          currentdict      end      image
    }{ %else      ImageWidth ImageHeight NumBits [ 1 0 0 1 0 0 ]          {
decode_gray_rle } image      currentfile 1 string readhexstring pop pop   %
consume Hex EOD marker      { %loop          currentfile 80 string readline
pop          (>) search { %ifelse           pop pop pop exit          }{ %else
        pop          } ifelse      } loop    % consume RunLength EOD (a '>'
character)
    } ifelse } bind def

% Color setting procs *******************************************************

% Set current RGB color /C   % r g b C - { %def
    setrgbcolor } bind def

% Set current gray value /G /setgray load def

% P  - Set current pseudocolor index % PG - Set current pseudogray index
Level2 { %ifelse
    % Assumes colorspace has been set during image output.
    /P    % ind P -
    { %def      setcolor
    } bind def
    /PG   % ind PG -
    { %def      setcolor
    } bind def }{ %else
    systemdict /colorimage known { %ifelse      % Colormap should be an array
of RGB triples      /P   % ind P -      {          Colormap exch get    % get
triple          dup 0 get 255 div    % get r g b          exch dup 1 get 255
div          exch 2 get 255 div          setrgbcolor      } bind def
    }{ %else      % Graymap should be a string of gray values      /P   % ind
P -      {      Graymap exch get 255 div      setgray      } bind def
    } ifelse
    /PG   % ind PG -
    {      Graymap exch get 255 div      setgray
    } bind def } ifelse

% Line drawing procs ********************************************************

    [3] 0 setdash } bind def

% Set line style to solid.  /LS % - LS - { %def
    [] 0 setdash } bind def

% Set line width.  /LW % width LW - {
    setlinewidth } bind def

% Draw a line.  /L  % x2 y2 x1 y1 L - { %def
    newpath
    moveto
    lineto
    stroke } bind def

    newpath
    moveto
    lineto
    lineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

    newpath
    moveto
    lineto
    lineto
    lineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% Text procs (for plotting) *************************************************

% Use Helvetica for all (plotting) text.  /FVFont /Helvetica-Bold findfont def

% Nominal text size.  /TextSize 16 def

% Set text size /SZ  % size SZ - {
    dup /TextSize exch def    % remember nominal text size
    FVFont exch scalefont setfont } bind def

% Draw a horizontal text string, starting at (x,y).  /HT % text x y HT - {
%def
    moveto
    show } bind def

% Draw a vertical text string, starting at (x,y).  /VT % text x y VT - { %def
    moveto
    gsave      90 rotate      show
    grestore } bind def

/TX  % text halign valign is_vertical x y TX - { %def
    moveto
    /is_vertical exch def
    /valign exch def
    /halign exch def
    is_vertical { gsave 90 rotate } if
    % valign is < 0 (align bottom), 0 (align middle), or > 0 (align top)
    valign 0 ge { %if not < 0, then not default (align bottom)      TextSize
% base vertical alignment on nominal (not actual) height      valign 0 gt {
%ifelse          % align top          neg 0 exch rmoveto      }{ % else
(valign is 0)          % align middle          -2 div 0 exch rmoveto      }
ifelse
    } if
    % halign is < 0 (align left), 0 (align center), or > 0 (align right)
    halign 0 ge { %if not < 0, then not default (align left)      dup
stringwidth pop      halign 0 gt { %ifelse          % align right          neg
0 rmoveto      }{ % else (halign is 0)          % align middle          -2 div
0 rmoveto      } ifelse
    } if
    show
    is_vertical { grestore } if } bind def

% Plotting symbols **********************************************************

% For all symbols, "x y" is the position of the upper left corner of the %
symbol's bounding box, and "size" is the height and width of the % (square)
bounding box.

% Draw a filled square symbol.  /SS % size x y SS - { %def
    newpath
    moveto
    dup 0 rlineto
    dup neg 0 exch rlineto
    neg 0 rlineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% Draw a filled diamond symbol.  /DS % size x y DS - { %def
    newpath
    moveto
    2 div
    dup 0 rmoveto
    dup dup neg rlineto
    dup neg dup rlineto
    neg dup neg rlineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% Draw a filled plus symbol.  /PS % size x y PS - { %def
    newpath
    moveto
    3 div
    dup 0 rmoveto
    dup 0 rlineto
    dup neg 0 exch rlineto
    dup 0 rlineto
    dup neg 0 exch rlineto
    dup neg 0 rlineto
    dup neg 0 exch rlineto
    dup neg 0 rlineto
    dup 0 exch rlineto
    dup neg 0 rlineto
    dup 0 exch rlineto
    0 rlineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% Draw a filled cross ("X") symbol.  /XS % size x y XS - { %def
    gsave      % Use a 45-degree rotated plus symbol.      2 index 2 div  %
size x y size/2      3 copy         % size x y size/2 x y size/2      3 -1
roll     % size x y size/2 y size/2 x      add       % size x y size/2 y
x+size/2      3 1 roll  % size x y x+size/2 size/2 y      exch sub  % size x y
x+size/2 y-size/2      translate 45 rotate % size x y      2 index 2 div  %
size x y size/2      3 copy         % size x y size/2 x y size/2      3 -1
roll  % size x y size/2 y size/2 x      add neg        % size x y size/2 y
-(x+size/2)      3 1 roll  % size x y -(x+size/2) size/2 y      sub       %
size x y -(x+size/2) -(y-size/2)      translate % size x y      PS
    grestore } bind def

% Draw a filled triangle symbol.  /TS % size x y TS - { %def
    newpath
    moveto
    dup 2 div 0 rmoveto
    dup dup 2 div exch neg rlineto
    neg 0 rlineto
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% Draw a filled circle symbol.  /CS % size x y CS - { %def
    newpath
    3 -1 roll 2 div % x y r
    dup dup 5 2 roll     % r r x y r
    sub 4 1 roll    % y-r r r x
    add             % y-r r x+r
    3 1 roll        % x+r y-r r
    0 360 arc
    closepath
    fill } bind def

% ****************************************************************************

end  % FVDict
